body:
Inventory upper budgets alone leave discrete threshold-count information unused. This change adds a lower-count construction from the physical inventory lower budget and actual finite supports, then emits a signed two-sided Gini chord in the canonical LP/target/terminal writer. The old TC aggregate remains present, constants and negative coefficients are preserved, and no columns are added.

The decision is **research-only; stop complete-method promotion**. R137 stable GI-TBC and the existing R138/R139 entries retain their bytes. The separate Round140 entry defaults to the tested old TC+stock combination, with explicit `--counts tc2` for reproducing the two-sided candidate.

- TC2 improves all five matched optimized LP domains beyond old TC+stock. The K20 increment is 0.01027985698 and K35 is 0.007955272454; the small RX20 increment is confirmed with tight tolerances.
- Stronger LP bounds do not translate into a uniformly better complete method. K35 TC2 ends at U/L = 0.7021486134 / 0.5419703766, worse than the accepted stock reference and the new old-TC control.
- Old TC+stock completes eight Seed0 configurations. Its largest Seed0 stock repair on RB35-T2 does not survive the decision-relevant Seed1: U/L = 0.3730513800 / 0.2308383524 versus accepted stock Seed1 0.3222448417 / 0.2311394491. Reused references retain their original source/PE and clocks; these are matched method comparisons, not same-PE causal interventions.

Validation covers 473 thresholds cross-checked by two constructions, exact rational block witnesses with explicit strictness limits, 11 standalone continuous LP diagnostics (9 main plus 2 precision confirmations), 14 formal complete positions plus 2 qualifications, all 79 actual Native call matrices, and local semantic/physical/seal/lifecycle checks on all 16 entered positions. Five selected trajectories contain 137 saved records (132 MIPSOL), not independent experiments. Independent mathematics/writer preflight, selection and all-nine-page PDF integration reviews are retained. The return-product alternative stops at offline screening; it is not a third complete benchmark line.

New experimental computation is **21831.718967 seconds (6.064366 h) of 43200 seconds**; even the conservative outer wall including pure postverification is 21932.245613 seconds. Nested H/LP/MIP costs are not counted twice. Open results retain null certification times, adverse outcomes and failures are preserved, and builds/documents/public I/O are separate.

Fixed science: [report](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/tree/15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678/results/unified_exact_round140/final_report.md), [mathematics](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/tree/15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678/results/unified_exact_round140/mathematical_analysis.md), [paper increment](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/tree/15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678/results/unified_exact_round140/manuscript.pdf), [19-carrier manifest](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/tree/15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678/results/unified_exact_round140/carrier_manifest.json), and [independent integration review](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/tree/15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678/results/unified_exact_round140/review/final_integration_review.json). Measured production C++ source is `81ab886e23220be97a858e66961056cef727d074`; the immutable science/source/raw publication is `15e401f794bb53e31c5848e0edabf0b4153ca678`. Later PR, bounded anonymous byte/member recovery, cleanup and cost receipts are additive delivery metadata, without rebuilding these carriers; see [current closeout](https://github.com/yifanXovo/TailoredExact/blob/codex/round140-two-sided-threshold-count/results/unified_exact_round140/RESUME.md).

The next bounded question is whether explicit per-vehicle linear return bounds improve the old-TC K35 common domain before attributing any gain to return products.
title: Round140: strengthen Gini threshold counts with two-sided inventory budgets
